title: Switch mimid's Chat/kick|ban|unban to ChatBan objects and the kickMembers patch key
description: jmap-chat-spec 516c61b adds ChatBan (base draft) and kickMembers (jmap-chat-mimi §Moderation). Waiting on the crate-jmap session for the ChatBan type, handlers, MemoryBackend support and ChatBackend hooks (requested 2026-11-19, Mark's choice). Then mimid-agent-jmap maps ChatBan create/destroy to Agent::ban/unban and kickMembers to Agent::kick, and drops the invented methods (decision mimid-1wgh.62); bump the crate-jmap pin.
notes:
crate-jmap session accepted 2026-11-19: epic JMAP-it7g (.1 ChatBan + hook, .2 kickMembers hook); hashes to follow.
crate-jmap landed: ChatBan f53460b1 (JMAP-it7g.1) — jmap-chat-types::ChatBan/ChatBanProperty, handle_chat_ban_get/changes/set, ChatBackend hooks create_chat_ban (like create_message; default stores + RemoveMembers group update, rolls back on failure), update_chat_ban, destroy_chat_ban (sweep_expired uses it, never re-adds); handler checks admin role + group kind first; addMembers of an actively banned user -> forbidden. kickMembers 88c22776 (JMAP-it7g.2): ChatBackend::kick_chat_members(caller, account_id, &Chat, &[Id]) -> Result<Result<(), SetError>, E>, called after validation before the rest of the patch; default rejects invalidProperties, so mimid must implement it. Not covered: federation Peer/deliver ChatBan check. Do together with mimid-sqxc (one crate-jmap bump past 88c22776; 45a18b35 breaking *_set options arg).
